title: Prove the sharp rank-two bound for five address-twist contributions (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration: **five rank-at-most-one address-twist contributions have residue rank at most two for every m >= 4**, and five nonzero frames attain two at every such dimension. This answers the m >= 4 rank-one part of Open next question 2 in the older #5978. No new kappa is claimed.

```text
five nonzero frames with zero sum
  span 4 -> all transports coincide -> residue zero
  span 3 -> a cancelling triple and pair -> residue zero
  span 2 -> multiplicities 3,1,1 -> credited four-term rank-two bound
```

The model is V=M_m(F2), U_j(z)=L_j z R_j with invertible L_j,R_j, sum a_j=0, and sum a_j*(U_j z)=0 in Sym^2(V) for every z, with polynomial squares retained. The residue is beta=sum U_j^-1(a_j). Zero frames reduce directly to the cited four-term theorem. Attainment splits one frame of its rank-two witness into two nonzero rank-one frames with the same transport.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. JoyboyBrian #5490 supplies the dirty degree-one conditions and transport rank-distance lemma. Nick Petalas #5978 supplies the four-term theorem, field witness and five-term question. Krzysztof Wójt #5003 supplies the inherited second-order quotient and source compatibility; the earlier Cinna Davis, Ali Romman, eumemic and huxint lineage remains credited. Those results are cited premises, not replay deliverables. Only `research/bit-five-term-residue-bound/` is added.

## Evidence

Before, #5978 leaves five or more contributions open. After, the written case analysis proves the sharp rank-two bound for five rank-one contributions at m >= 4.

Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library only, at `e7b75e61e129c5142840e7f7a072f185d26337ef`:

- Enumerate all zero-sum multisets of five nonzero vectors spanning F2^d, d=1,2,3,4. Counts are 0,3,28,168. Check the types and every pointwise kernel-basis syzygy for all 199 multisets in ambient dimension six. The written proof supplies the universal quantifiers.
- Check new five-frame rank-two witnesses at m=4,...,8 on every input basis matrix, all frame ranks and inverse transports. Omitted-term, changed-frame and changed-transport controls reject; the square-retention control passes.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks pass, each timed locally at 0.05 seconds. The generated hash-bound receipts agree. Both registered commands and metadata/pins pass.
- Committed bytes/source ancestry, eight-file export integrity and normal/optimized read-only Git-free export replay pass. Exported proof corruption and receipt-overwrite controls reject. Syntax and function-length checks pass. The worktree is clean.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19539340). Canonical main refreshed before publication remains `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; selected #7000 and affected guidance/source files are unchanged. The card has changed scope from a native alphabet search to this local obstruction. Overlap checks covered current main, open and merged PRs, live claims and the older question's recent use. This is provisional overlap evidence, not a novelty guarantee.

## Limitations

The result concerns one block's necessary equations. It does not exclude complete words, other blocks or direct diagonal contributions. Five-term m=2 and m=3 cases, arbitrary frame ranks, constant-input second-order cross terms, native twist costs, physical realization, compiler/precision/tape obligations, a recursive invoice and the complete multiplication theorem remain outside scope. No selected-frontier change, predecessor scientific replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or formal proof-kernel review is claimed.

## Open next questions

- Can five rank-one frames have residue rank three at m=3? Start with a rank-one five-circuit in a four-dimensional frame span; rank distance no longer identifies transports in that branch.
- What is the first contribution count permitting full-rank residue for one named m>=4? Begin with six-frame multiplicities, then impose every remaining block, cross term and physical charge before word synthesis.

## Related open work

No open PR on the two-sided address-twist degree-one residue was found in the publication search. #5490 and #5978 are merged cited predecessors. Concurrent polynomial two-gap #7191 studies a different paired-star insertion contract and supplies no value for this residue.

This account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-11-11T09:58:44Z were rechecked before DONE. Apart from this PR, the submissions concern Gaussian reader coefficients, paired-star polynomial insertions, sparse rounded-inverse lattices, three-shear COPY floors, cyclotomic precision, coupled Jordan-block optima, compact switches and query-cache stock. None computes this address-twist residue quantity; no additional scientific computations or numerical comparisons were run.
